message.content: Hey, can you help me draft a final invoice for the wedding shoot at The Foundry Warehouse? I need to send it out before EOD.

content.text: Sure, Thandiwe. I have the project details for the Nkosi wedding stored in your client folder. Shall I use your standard 50% deposit deducted rate, or do you want the full balance listed separately?

message.content: Standard. Deduct the 50% deposit. Make sure the itemized list includes the extra hour for the golden hour shots and the two edited album proofs.

content.text: Got it. I’ve added the +R2,500 for the extended hour and the R4,000 for the album proofs to the subtotal. The final balance due comes to R18,500. Does that look right?

message.content: Yes, that’s correct. Please generate the PDF and attach it to an email addressed to Sarah Nkosi. Use the subject line 'Final Invoice - Nkosi Wedding'.

content.text: Email drafted. The body includes a brief thank you note and your bank details for EFT. Shall I send it now?

message.content: Send it. And set a reminder for me to follow up in five days if I haven’t received confirmation of payment.

content.text: Invoice sent and reminder set for March 14th. Is there anything else you need help with before you head out?
